tag_size_definition: outer edge of the black border, measured with a caliper
plate_frame: tag centres in the sticker plane, mm, relative to the first tag of the plate; the three centres form an equilateral triangle with 13 mm sides
pixel_convention: origin at the top-left corner of the image; the centre of the top-left pixel is (0.5, 0.5)
corner_order: OpenCV ArUco order: the tag's top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left corner in its own frame
detector: OpenCV ArUco, DICT_APRILTAG_36h11, with sub-pixel corner refinement
plate_names: labels only; they do not describe where a sticker sits on the object
